name: Nezumi
description: Rat-like people held captive in wicker cages, including Nashi.

description_citations.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
description_citations.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Following weeks of searching for Tezzeret, Kaito travels into the nezumi swamp to find the child Nashi.
timeline.quote: But the key to finding Tezzeret was with the nezumi.

citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The group discovers a clearing where wickerfolk dance around a cold fire next to cages of nezumi captives.
timeline.quote: There were seven in all, four of them occupied by humanoid rats

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: A wickerfolk plants bamboo in a captive nezumi, turning it into a woven doll that joins the dance.
timeline.quote: The rat-person was gone, leaving a woven wicker doll behind, lifeless and limp.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer frees the other captive nezumi, who say wickerfolk fear fire.
timeline.quote: The Wanderer dodged them easily, moving to cut the other occupied cages open.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

relations.note: Tezzeret retaliated when they refused to sell their land and burned the village
relations.quote: But when the nezumi refused to sell their land, Tezzeret retaliated.

citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.
